info.title: Sift Sync API
info.description:
Sift is a browser-first RSS reader. This API exposes your subscription state (feeds, read/starred flags) and aggregate feed-reading statistics for AI agents and other tools. Agents are first-class sync devices: they authenticate with a scoped, revocable agent token and can read your feeds and change subscriptions.

Get started: open Sift Settings → Sync → Agents → pair an agent, then redeem the 8-character code via POST /sync/tokens/redeem to obtain a token (23 characters, starts with 't'). Send it in the X-Sync-Key header.

Hosted chat tools (ChatGPT, Claude web) cannot POST or send headers. They can read with the pairing code directly: GET /sync/pull?code=<code> works with no headers and stays valid until the code's 5-minute expiry. To add a feed, such agents propose a link of the form /?intent=add&url=<feed-url> (URL-encoded) — the user clicks it and approves the add in the app; the agent never writes directly.

Security notes:
- Agent tokens can only call GET /sync/pull, GET /sync/stats/pull, and POST /sync/push. Statistics writes are master-key-only.
- Aggregate statistics contain feed identities, counters, and lifetime-read marker identities only; they do not contain article content or reading-event history.
- A token grants read/write of the subscriptions it is bound to. Revoke it anytime from Settings; revocation takes effect immediately. Rotating the sync key orphans all tokens.
- A pairing code on GET /sync/pull or GET /sync/stats/pull is read-only and expires in 5 minutes; it can appear in chat history — treat it as a short-lived read capability.
- Writes carry NO timestamps: the server stamps every write with its own monotonic time. Send bare field values.

X-Sync-Key.name: X-Sync-Key
X-Sync-Key.description: The agent token (23 chars, starts with 't') obtained from POST /sync/tokens/redeem, or the master sync key. Agent tokens work only on pull and push.

FeedPatch.description: A subscription change. All fields are bare values — the server stamps every write, so never send timestamps.

feedId.description: The feed row id. Reuse the feed_id from a pull when the URL is already subscribed; otherwise use the feed URL.

deleted.description: 0 = subscribe/re-subscribe, 1 = unsubscribe (tombstone). Metadata-only pushes omit this field.

FlagPatch.description: A read/starred change for one item. Bare values only.

itemId.description: encodeURIComponent(feedId) + '::' + guid, where guid follows the browser's identity rules (guid ?? id, else link|published, else link).

StatsPatch.description: An approximate observed-volume snapshot. The server derives readOnce from lifetime-read markers; clients must not send a readOnce value.

ReadMarkerPatch.description: A compact lifetime-read marker for one canonical item identity.

itemId.description: Encoded item identity, using the same format as FlagPatch.itemId.

serverTime.description: Monotonic statistics cursor for the next statistics pull.
Monotonic server time. Use as the `since` cursor of your next pull.

feeds.description: Rows with row_at >= since. Tombstoned rows carry deleted=1; filter them out for the live list.

fingerprint.description: 4-char display fingerprint (SHA-256, first 20 bits, Crockford base32).

post.summary: Exchange an agent pairing code for a token
post.description: Public. The code comes from Sift Settings → Sync → Agents. One-time use, 5-minute expiry. The returned token is 23 characters, starts with 't'.

get.description: Returns feeds and flags with row_at >= since, plus the new serverTime to use as the next cursor. since=0 returns everything. Authenticate with the X-Sync-Key header (master key or agent token), or — for hosted chat agents that cannot send headers — pass the 8-character agent pairing code in the `code` query parameter. A code authenticates read-only, is multi-use until its 5-minute expiry, and is brute-force guarded per IP. Responses are Cache-Control: no-store.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous pull's serverTime; 0 for the full dump.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Agent pairing code from Settings → Sync → Agents. Alternative to the X-Sync-Key header; read-only; valid until expiry. Mutually exclusive with the header.

429.description: Rate limited (per sync key, or per IP for code pulls)

post.description: PATCH semantics with bare values — the server stamps every write with its own monotonic time. Sending a legacy {value, at} shape is rejected with 400. Agent tokens are allowed. Rows are delivered to devices in arrival order via pull.

post.summary: Push aggregate feed-reading statistics (master key only)
post.description: Pushes approximate observed-volume snapshots and compact once-read marker identities. The server derives readOnce atomically from ever-read state and returns marker acknowledgements plus authoritative affected aggregates. Agent tokens are rejected.

401.description: Missing, revoked, invalid, or agent-token credential

get.description: Returns aggregate rows and lifetime-read marker identities with row_at >= since. Uses an independent statistics cursor and contains no article content or event history. Authenticate with the X-Sync-Key header or an agent pairing code.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Statistics cursor from the previous response; 0 for the full baseline.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Agent pairing code alternative to X-Sync-Key; read-only until expiry.

post.description: Idempotent user creation. Agent tokens are rejected with 401.

post.summary: Mint a device pairing code (master-key only)
post.description: Issues an 8-character code another Sift browser redeems to join the sync group. Agent tokens are rejected with 401 — a device code redeems to the master key.

post.summary: Exchange a device pairing code for the sync key (for Sift browsers)
post.description: Public, for the Sift device-pairing flow only. Agent pairing codes are NOT accepted here — use POST /sync/tokens/redeem.

200.description: Sync key (master credential — treat as secret)

post.summary: Mint an agent pairing code (master-key only)
post.description: Issues an 8-character code that POST /sync/tokens/redeem exchanges for a revocable agent token. Agent tokens are rejected with 401.

get.description: Metadata only — raw tokens are never returned. Use the fingerprint to match a token shown by your tool.

delete.description: Revocation is immediate; the token stops working on the next request.
